case_name: Haridas Exports v All India Float Glass Manufacturers' Assn. and Others
respondent: All India Float Glass Manufacturers' Assn.
holding: The MRTP Commission will get jurisdiction to act under S. 37(1) of the MRTP Act only if the cartel carries out Restrictive Trade Practice in India or its actions have the effect of a Restrictive Trade Practice being carried out in India.
cases_cited: Chapter V contains provisions relating to restrictive trade practices
